summary.headline: Florentine Codex of Geomancy and Omens
summary.text: Description of Codex Laur. LXXXVI, 14, a fifteenth-century Florentine manuscript with geomancy, planetary and cometary omens, zodiacal calculations, magical remedies, gospel and psaltery prognostics, and interpretations of the Ramplion and twelve figures. Authorities and associated works include Aristotle, Apuleius Romanus, Lydus’s De ostentis, Leo the Wise, and John of Damascus.
